allow: PowerShell($c = Get-Command az -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($c\) { $c.Source } else { "az NOT FOUND in PATH" })
PowerShell(wsl -d Ubuntu -- bash -lc "for t in az terraform databricks python3 jq; do printf '%s -> ' \\$t; command -v \\$t || echo 'not found'; done")
Bash(wsl.exe -d Ubuntu -- bash -lc 'for t in az terraform databricks python3 jq; do printf "%s -> " "$t"; command -v "$t" || echo "not found"; done')
Bash(printf '%s\\n' '#!/bin/bash' 'for t in az terraform databricks python3 jq; do' '  p=$\(command -v "$t" 2>/dev/null\)' '  echo "$t -> ${p:-NOT FOUND}"' done)
PowerShell(wsl -d Ubuntu -- bash -c "sudo -n true 2>&1 && echo SUDO_NOPASSWD || echo SUDO_NEEDS_PASSWORD; id -un; lsb_release -cs")

PowerShell(wsl -d Ubuntu -- bash -c "python3 -V; python3 -m venv --help >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo VENV_OK || echo VENV_MISSING; for t in curl unzip wget pip3 gcc; do printf '%s=' \\$t; command -v \\$t >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo yes || echo no; done; uname -m; echo HOME=\\$HOME")

PowerShell(wsl -d Ubuntu -- bash -c "ls -l ~/.local/bin/ 2>/dev/null; echo '--- curl test ---'; curl -sS -o /dev/null -w 'terraform_zip=%{http_code}\\n' https://releases.hashicorp.com/terraform/1.9.8/terraform_1.9.8_linux_amd64.zip; curl -sS -o /dev/null -w 'hashicorp_index=%{http_code}\\n' https://releases.hashicorp.com/terraform/; curl -sS -o /dev/null -w 'github=%{http_code}\\n' https://github.com/databricks/cli/releases/latest; echo '--- proxy env ---'; env | grep -i proxy || echo none")
PowerShell(wsl -d Ubuntu -- bash -c '$HOME/.local/bin/az account show -o json 2>&1 | head -20; echo "--- PATH check ---"; grep -n "local/bin" $HOME/.profile $HOME/.bashrc 2>/dev/null | head')
PowerShell(wsl -d Ubuntu -- bash -c 'rm -f /tmp/azlogin.log; nohup $HOME/.local/bin/az login > /tmp/azlogin.log 2>&1 & echo "pid=$!"')
PowerShell(wsl -d Ubuntu -- bash -c 'cat /tmp/azlogin.log; echo "--- listeners ---"; ss -ltnp 2>/dev/null | grep -E "84[0-9][0-9]|LISTEN" | head')
PowerShell(wsl -d Ubuntu -- bash -c 'cat /tmp/azlogin.log 2>/dev/null || echo "\(log vacio todavia\)"')
PowerShell(wsl -d Ubuntu -- bash -c 'git ls-remote https://github.com/brrsanchezfi/DKOps.git 2>&1 | head -8')
